evidence: The cobalt precursor was CoCp2 (98% Strem Chemicals) and oxygen plasma was the oxidant. The CoCp2 precursor bubbler was heated up to 80°C and bubbled with 200 sccm of high-purity Ar gas during the precursor exposure half-cycles. Oxygen gas flow was held constant at 60 sccm throughout the deposition process. The precursor lines, carrier gas lines, and the reactor walls were kept at 120°C.
